High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 22750 of 2023
Applicant :- Anuj Verma And Another

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shiva Tripathi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saral Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash entire proceedings of Case No.9634 of
2022, arising out of Case Crime No.56 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B I.P.C.,
Police Station Hapur Nagar, District Hapur, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
District Hapur.

entities.text:
Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
District Hapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that no offence against the applicants is disclosed and
the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of causing
Anuj Verma And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023
He pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his contention.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant though argued the matter vehemently, but could not make out a case for quashing of the entire proceeding of aforesaid case.

He lastly submits that appropriate direction be issued to the Court below to consider the bail application of the applicants in accordance with law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922.
5.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
However, considering the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants, it is directed that the applicants shall surrender before the concerned court below within four weeks from today, and in case they apply for bail, the bail application of the applicants shall be disposed of expeditiously by the courts below in accordance with law and keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922.
6.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the above observations and directions, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
